sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins (with one draw before that), host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a heavily favourable fixture on paper: Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five outings, making this an opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead further.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash that could prove significant. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth and in fine form, host Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town, sitting sixth with good recent results, play away at Foley Meir. The remaining fixtures see Brereton Social host struggling Widnes Town (who have won none of their seven games), Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle of the division's bottom sides, Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, Market Drayton Town host New Mills, and Shawbury United travel to Barnton—most of these involving sides struggling in the lower half of the table.
